Acceptance:
- each unique REQUEST/SPEC/PLAN/memory claim maps to retained original or evidence-bound destination

- isolated fixture only: exact approved candidate, complete references, retention and verified backup permit staged recoverable retirement
- changed approval target/content/HEAD or unknown external reference rejects retirement

- age, zero static references or git history alone never authorizes removal
- normal work uses incremental gardening after docs/review; explicit full-cleanup Work is separate and any applied fixture change is reverified
- small UI change cannot trigger automatic whole-repository document deletion or unverified cleanup
